# Build candidate annotation and validate every source quote is exact substring of its source segment.
def q(docid, line, quote):
    sid=f"IK-{docid}:L{line}"
    assert quote in docs[docid][sid], (sid, quote, docs[docid][sid])
    return {"source_id": sid, "quote": quote}
